page.layout: One column of running text, with small marginal notes in the left margin beside the lines of the last part. Running head at the top (P. VOET), page number at the top left, catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: respondeat, culpam penes eum residere, qui prior flagello per-cusserat; ut primus ictus vide-atur exspectandus. Respon-deo enim in delictis non tam finem & exitum, quam qui-dem principium, & praepara-menta inspici solere. Unde si qui auctor erat rixae, primùm percussisset, penes eum culpa erat, quod ab eodem pugna habuerit initium; quę facti spe-cies est in responso objecto. Verùm aliter sese.res habet in ca-su nostro, ubi qui ferit adver-sarium invadentem, & ini-quum aggressorem, causam percussionis aut delicti nullam praebuit; ut extra culpam sic constitutus. Neque obstat 2. Quod non teneatur poenâ l.l.1.§.3[?], D. Ad l. Cornel. de Sicar. Corneliae de Sicariis, qui gladium strinxerit; nisi etiam per-cusserit. Respondeo enim, ut judex ordinariam l. Corneliae poenam irrogare valeat, non

page.notes: Left margin note: the printed lines read "l.1.§.3," "D. Ad l.", "Cornel.", "de Sicar."; the first token is uncertain and is marked [?]. Long s (s) converted to plain s throughout, including "fi" in "Unde si" and "fefe.res" read as "sese.res" (uncertain, marked by reading only). "eft" read as est in the original text "eft in responso" (not in this page; the page reads "spe-cies est in responso"). The word "suffi:" at the foot right is a catchword and is not part of the text. Bottom-right watermark and top-right speck are not printed text.
